entry_barrier.description: How easy is it for a first-time contractor with no past performance to win this?

rules.description: Opportunity is SBIR or STTR (designed for new entrants)
Set-aside I can compete on (Total SB, Partial SB, unrestricted)
SDVOSB, 8(a), HUBZone, WOSB — HARD DISQUALIFIER, score → 0
Past performance not required or not heavily weighted
Explicitly encourages new vendors / emerging small businesses
Micro-purchase under $25K
Small value $25K–$100K
Medium value $100K–$250K
Large value $250K–$500K (need teaming partner)
Over $500K — not realistic for first-time solo
No specialized facility, lab, or manufacturing floor required

scope_simplicity.description: Can one person actually do this work?

rules.description: Deliverable is a study, report, analysis, design, or prototype
Scope appears achievable by 1–2 people
Specific, bounded deliverables (not open-ended IDIQ / managed services)
Period of performance under 12 months
RFI / Sources Sought — low effort, builds relationships

competition_level.description: How many competitors will I face, and are they advantaged?

rules.description: SBIR/STTR limited innovation-focused competitor pool
Small business set-aside limits competition
Not a recompete with an established incumbent
Technical topic limits competitors (robotics, mechatronics, etc.)

skill_match.description: How well does this match my actual capabilities?

rules.description: Directly matches core skills (mechatronics, 3D printing, PCB, embedded, soft robotics, EOP…)
Adjacent — could do with modest effort (data analysis, tech writing, prototyping…)
Generic services I could do but aren't my strengths
Parts/commodity procurement (NSN, FSC code title, repair-of) — keyword match suppressed, 0 pts

notice_type_modifier.description: Notice type bonus applied in entry_barrier scoring

rules.description: Solicitation or Combined Synopsis/Solicitation — actively biddable
Presolicitation — pipeline visibility
Sources Sought — respond to shape acquisition
Special Notice — review for relevance
Broad Agency Announcement — ideal solo R&D instrument

hard_disqualifiers.description: If ANY trigger, auto-set score=0 and status=SKIP regardless of other scoring

rules.detection: security clearance required / TS/SCI / TOP SECRET / SECRET clearance / facility clearance required / SCIF
rules.note: 'background investigation' alone is NOT a disqualifier

rules.detection: Set-aside is SDVOSB, VOSB, 8(a), HUBZone, WOSB, or EDWOSB
'ITAR restricted' or 'ITAR compliance required'. 'May be subject to ITAR' is a WARNING, not a disqualifier.
classified information / classified contract / classified program
explosives / ordnance / nuclear weapon / chemical weapon / biological weapon / munitions
authorized reseller / OEM partnership required / certified [vendor] integrator
5+ FTE / large staff headcount explicitly required
manufacturing facility / cleanroom / SCIF / accredited laboratory / production facility
Notice type is Award Notice — contract already awarded, nothing to bid
